cases.title: An edit to a pair the learner said should land hard: the mentor says it saw it, nothing more; the pair is not graded or taught

rubric.reason: Turn 3 says once "I also saw your change to the last Position move, the slam. That one's yours to shape however you want." It gives no verdict, no harder/softer advice and no ask to undo it, and the turn still says the other three pairs pass.

All names and times appear in the snapshot and check results or the learner record (Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s, 1.5–3 s and 3–4.37 s rounded from 4.367, Scale, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, and Title eased before).

Each turn moves one step and ends on a learner action: turn 1 is the proposal and leave-outs ending on the land-hard question, turn 2 drops the slam and asks the reading question, and turn 3 says "That passes" with the pairs and ends on the read-again question.
